title: Issue-guided analogue for diagnostics bus-message-count path
purpose: Exercise a diagnostics request with explicit subfunction and data fields so the parser traverses a control-function path distinct from addressed read and write requests while keeping length and field sizes internally consistent.
expected_behavior: A Modbus/TCP implementation should delimit the ADU using the stated MBAP length, parse function 0x08 with a 2-byte subfunction and 2-byte data field, and then either process the diagnostics request or return a clean exception response.
constraints_preserved: MBAP Length is 0006, matching unit identifier plus the 5-byte diagnostics PDU.
Diagnostics request layout is preserved as function code plus 2-byte subfunction plus 2-byte data.
The frame is complete and contains no trailing bytes beyond the declared ADU length.
Where exact Modbus/TCP support for this diagnostics subfunction is not fully specified by supplied sources, the seed remains a conservative full-frame analogue intended to test controlled handling.
issue_safety_notes: The seed is length-consistent and fully framed. It does not use underlength MBAP values, extra trailing bytes, or any exact prior issue payload.
